fact_check_verdict: The official Alaska Department of Health workbook verifies Ryan Air as a selected implementation proposal with a projected preliminary award of $4,171,115. It proposes autonomous cargo drones and electric vertical-takeoff-and-landing aircraft for medicines and medical transport. Nothing in the official materials establishes that aircraft were purchased, FAA approvals were obtained, communities consented, or flights began.

claims.spoken: Alaska lists a projected preliminary award of four million one hundred seventy-one thousand one hundred fifteen dollars.
requires: Always pair the amount with projected and preliminary. The program page says budget finalization is still in progress and amounts may change.

claims.spoken: Ryan Air proposes autonomous cargo drones and electric vertical takeoff and landing aircraft.
claims.on_screen: RYAN AIR PROPOSAL · AUTONOMOUS CARGO DRONES + EVTOL
requires: Autonomous modifies cargo drones in the workbook. Do not imply the passenger-carrying EVTOL aircraft are autonomous.
Keep proposal framing. Do not say the new service exists today.

claims.spoken: The project summary names the Bethel and Dillingham regions.
requires: Do not describe the structured service-area field as identical. It differs.

claims.spoken: A separate service area field lists Anchorage, Bristol Bay, Dillingham and Yukon Koyukuk.
claims.on_screen: SERVICE FIELD · ANCHORAGE · BRISTOL BAY · DILLINGHAM · YUKON-KOYUKUK
requires: State that this is a separate workbook field. Do not resolve the mismatch on the state's behalf.

claims.spoken: The official notice does not document an aircraft purchase, an F A A approval or a completed flight.
claims.on_screen: NO PURCHASE · NO FAA APPROVAL · NO COMPLETED FLIGHT DOCUMENTED
requires: This is an absence in the cited official materials, not proof those milestones will never occur.

claims.spoken: Ryan Air's proposal describes severe gaps in pharmaceutical access and medical transport.
requires: Attribute this problem statement to the proposal. Do not present near-total lack as an independently measured state finding.

claims.spoken: The state says budget finalization is still in progress and projected amounts may change.
claims.on_screen: BUDGET FINALIZATION IN PROGRESS · AMOUNTS MAY CHANGE
requires: Do not call the preliminary amount a final grant payment.

claims.spoken: Commercial package delivery by drone needs F A A certification and operating authorization.
claims.on_screen: CARGO TEST · FAA PART 135 + OPERATING AUTHORIZATION
requires: Do not imply Ryan Air already holds approvals for the proposed cargo drone operation.

claims.spoken: Passenger electric aircraft face a different test for the aircraft, pilot and operation.
requires: Do not call the proposed passenger aircraft autonomous. Do not imply certification is complete.

claims.spoken: Ryan Air says it serves more than seventy villages with conventional aircraft.
claims.on_screen: RYAN AIR SAYS · 24 AIRCRAFT · 8 HUBS · 70+ VILLAGES
requires: Attribute to Ryan Air. Existing rural aviation experience does not prove autonomous-drone or eVTOL readiness.

claims.spoken: The proposal would use cargo drones to carry pharmaceuticals.
requires: Keep would, could or proposes. Do not say deliveries have begun.

claims.spoken: The proposal would use electric aircraft to transport patients and healthcare providers.
requires: Keep proposed framing. Do not call the passenger aircraft autonomous or operational.

claims.spoken: The official notice does not document a route.
requires: This is an absence in the cited official materials, not proof a route will never be chosen.
